task: Close the PR #347 review follow-ups: workdir checker false negatives, release validator trust, ADR tree-equality evidence

events.summary: Only the workdir checker + tests, check-portal-release-ref.py (--repo) + tests, portal-release.yml (validator checkout) and the two ADR-0001 files change; portal-docker-publish.yml, portal/ and the cluster are untouched. PR #355 round adds docs/common/lessons-log.md; portal-docker-publish.yml still untouched.

The pre-change checker (git show origin/main:scripts/ci/check-workflow-workdir.py) exits 0 on four fixture workflows that must fail: workflow-level default with no checkout, workflow-level default with a conditional checkout, checkout into with.path 'elsewhere', and a run step between a conditional and the later unconditional checkout; the new checker exits 1 on all four. Run against the old copy, 9 of the 19 new unit tests fail (CWW_SCRIPT override). The old check-portal-release-ref.py rejects --repo ('unrecognized arguments').

check-workflow-workdir.py now resolves the effective default (job, else workflow level), requires the first UNCONDITIONAL checkout into the root or exactly the workdir (with.path), rejects run steps (without their own working-directory) and local actions before it. portal-release.yml checks out github.sha (workflow_run: last commit on default branch, per GitHub docs) into trusted/ and runs the validator from there with --repo . at the tagged checkout; check-portal-release-ref.py gained --repo with 2 tests. ADR-0001 (en/ko) records git rev-parse e8e8229d:portal '39c0079^{tree}' printing 8a50ade5f710b14732b1ce12f05ebddd16d67862 twice.

PR #355 review round: portal-release.yml checked out the tagged commit into the workspace root and trusted/ inside it, so a tagged tree with a symlink or directory named trusted could shadow it or make actions/checkout clean the root. Roles inverted: the default-branch tip (github.sha, persist-credentials false) is the workspace root and runs scripts/ci/check-portal-release-ref.py --repo tagged; the tagged commit is checked out only under tagged/; the changelog and NOTICE/LICENSE/THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md are extracted as git blobs after an ls-tree regular-file (100644/100755) check; trivy scans tagged/portal. Checker: a run step before the first unconditional checkout with a relative own working-directory now fails (only ., github.workspace, runner.temp, absolute paths pass); jobs with uses: and no steps are skipped. Tests: symlink-named-trusted tagged repo with --repo tagged, 4 workflow layout tests (fail on the committed workflow), 5 checker tests (3 fail on the committed checker).
